decisions: explicit runtime roots were seeded before mechanical descendant and listener enumeration
limitations: rematch-during-load: The rematch callback is registered on the closure-private active client only after client creation; the immutable page exposes no public or E2E seam that can invoke it while a later startGame call is pending.
quit-during-load: The quit callback is closure-private HUD wiring; during pending initial client creation the immutable page has no runtime-reachable quit control or external callback handle.
destroy-during-lazy-import: The lazy NetworkClient import and HUD instance are closure-private, and the immutable page exports no E2E destroy hook capable of destroying the realm during that import.

stale-completion: The generation token and asynchronous completion guards are closure-private; the immutable page exposes no external driver that can supersede a start and release its completion deterministically.
omissions: excluded match ledger, route-only, progression, lobby, account, and gameplay-world canvas owners
